cues.label: Surface clamp lock
cues.trigger: Confirm a turret latched onto a floor, table, or wall.

cues.label: Hover-pod deploy
cues.trigger: Confirm a turret detached into repulsor hover.

cues.label: Invalid placement buzz
cues.trigger: Signal a rejected turret placement.

cues.label: Relocate teleport
cues.trigger: Confirm a turret snapped to its new position.

cues.label: Sell chime
cues.trigger: Confirm that selling a turret refunded requisition.

cues.label: Radial tick / confirm
cues.trigger: Mark a selection or confirmation in the radial menu.

cues.label: Autocannon burst
cues.trigger: Mark the Autocannon’s burst fire.

cues.label: Autocannon impact
cues.trigger: Mark a kinetic hit against an invader.

cues.label: Plasma Mortar launch
cues.trigger: Mark a Plasma Mortar shell leaving its turret.

cues.label: Plasma Mortar detonation
cues.trigger: Mark the Plasma Mortar’s area hit.

cues.label: Cryo-Arc charge
cues.trigger: Telegraph the Cryo-Arc turret’s discharge.

cues.label: Cryo-Arc chain zap
cues.trigger: Mark a Cryo-Arc jump between targets.

cues.label: Rail Sniper charge
cues.trigger: Telegraph a charged Rail Sniper shot.

cues.label: Rail Sniper crack
cues.trigger: Mark the Rail Sniper’s charged shot.

cues.label: Turret rotate servo
cues.trigger: Give audible feedback when a turret slews.

cues.label: Tier upgrade power-up
cues.trigger: Confirm a new turret tier.

cues.label: Rift tear open
cues.trigger: Warn that a new enemy rift has opened.

cues.label: Rift ambient loop
cues.trigger: Locate an open rift by its sustained emitter.

cues.label: Skitter hiss / death
cues.trigger: Mark a Skitter breaking apart on death.

cues.label: Wasp buzz / pop
cues.trigger: Mark a flyer’s destruction in the air.

cues.label: Brute stomp / armor clang
cues.trigger: Mark a Brute's heavy armored footfall.

cues.label: Disruptor EMP
cues.trigger: Warn that a Disruptor has disabled nearby towers.

cues.label: Broodlord roar
cues.trigger: Telegraph the Apex Broodlord’s presence.

cues.label: Boss death collapse
cues.trigger: Mark the Apex Broodlord’s destruction.

cues.label: Incoming wave horn
cues.trigger: Announce the start of an incoming wave.

cues.label: Core shield hit
cues.trigger: Flag a successful hit on the Core shield.

cues.label: Core critical alarm
cues.trigger: Warn that the Core’s health is critical.

cues.label: Victory / defeat confirm
cues.trigger: Confirm acknowledgment on either mission result screen.
